name: Jingxing
source:
The topic that youth can never escape is graduation. Graduation is parting, graduation is the ultimate destination of youth.

Everyone's life node has been separated by graduation. The young people with high spirits and innocent girls have gone through the best years of youth.

Our heroes and heroines are also facing graduation today. Their future is uncertain and they are confused. Every little thing can stir up a big wave. We are like birds of fright. We don't know how to protect our little youth.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/994750/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
青春无法逃避的主题是毕业。毕业意味着离别，也是青春的终点。

每个人生命的节点都被毕业分隔。意气风发的年轻人与天真女孩共同度过了最美好的青春岁月。

如今，我们的男女主角也面临毕业。他们对未来感到不确定与困惑，每件小事都可能掀起巨浪。我们像受惊的鸟，不知道该如何守护短暂的青春。

[来源：[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/994750/]Steam[/url]]
